name: Brine Crown

reviewItem.gameplayVerb: Stationary area-control hazard that swells, raises spines, and grows corrosive brine patches instead of chasing the diver.
brief: Anchor: Vent-associated chemosynthetic mats and mineral crusts for a rooted abyssal footprint.
Anchor: Starfish-like radial arm logic for readable uneven rays and outward danger lanes.
Anchor: Toxic coral and brine-pool blister cues for corrosive sacs and warning colors.
Anchor: Hydrothermal chimney forms for a central crown cup and dark toxic throat.
Motion: Idle: basal mat pulses and brine blisters breathe faintly.
Motion: Telegraph: crown throat opens while blisters brighten sickly green amber.
Motion: Area denial: radial fronds lift and brine patches grow from arm tips.
Motion: Spine raise: rim spines lance upward in clear lanes.
Motion: Recovery: sacs deflate, spines retract, and the crown crusts over.
requiredRead: One rooted radial organism, not a collage of coral, starfish, and vent tubes.
Central crown or toxic throat is the first read.
Low anchored basal mat with uneven rays/fronds and visible hinge/root zones.
Readable toxic blisters, spine halo, and corrosive danger cues at game scale.
No loose detached parts, environmental shadows, haze, floor plane, or particles baked into the source.
reviewItem.prompt: Flat pure #ff00ff magenta background, isolated full-body 2D game creature source art, cohesive underwater threat called Brine Crown, stationary abyssal vent organism blending starfish toxic coral and hydrothermal flora into one rooted basal mat, central jagged crown cup with dark toxic throat, five to seven uneven thick radial arms/fronds fused into the mat, opaque brine blisters glowing sickly green amber, mineral spines around the rim, root-like tendrils, gloomy charcoal deep teal bone oxidized copper palette, crisp readable silhouette, crop-friendly hinge zones, no environment, no shadows, no haze, no duplicate creatures, no detached limbs, no text
promptRisks: Avoid a decorative reef; the source must read as a dangerous organism.
Avoid perfect radial ornament symmetry that feels like a logo.
Avoid magenta or hot pink body colors that will key out.
Avoid loose vent tubes or starfish arms that do not grow from the same mat.
Keep toxic clouds, bubbles, and brine puddles as separate VFX rather than baked source art.
reviewItem.notes: Draft source candidate imported from structured research brief. Do not rig until whole-source art passes source-candidate review.

manualVisualChecklist.label: Whole creature cohesion
manualVisualChecklist.detail: The source reads as one organism before any parts are cut.

manualVisualChecklist.label: Readable silhouette
manualVisualChecklist.detail: The outline is recognizable at game scale without relying on detail noise.

manualVisualChecklist.label: No collage artifacts
manualVisualChecklist.detail: Lighting, material language, and anatomy do not look stitched from unrelated pieces.

manualVisualChecklist.label: Non-placeholder art direction
manualVisualChecklist.detail: The source has a cohesive production-intent creature design, not proof-of-concept shapes or temporary stand-ins.

manualVisualChecklist.label: Crop-safe anatomy
manualVisualChecklist.detail: Appendages and joints have enough margin and mass to become articulated parts.

manualVisualChecklist.label: Clean magenta key
manualVisualChecklist.detail: The background is flat magenta and the body avoids magenta/pink values that will key out.

manualVisualChecklist.label: Gameplay read
manualVisualChecklist.detail: The visual design communicates its gameplay verb and danger shape.

reviewItem.acceptCommand: npm run source:accept -- --id brine-crown --status approved --reviewed-by <human-reviewer> --note 'Approved after inspecting the whole source before any rigging.' --source-reviewed
